entities.title: Hive
entities.summary: The 37 aliens in their slots, five rows across nine columns, swaying side to side; also one player's set of survivors, kept between turns.

entities.title: Queen
entities.summary: The crowned alien on the hive's top row; three in a hive. Diving, she is worth 200, 400 or 800.

entities.title: Guard
entities.summary: The magenta alien on the second row; seven in a hive. A guard beside a diving queen may fly with her as an escort.

entities.title: Drone
entities.summary: The orange alien on the third row; nine in a hive.

entities.title: Worker (alien)
entities.summary: The yellow alien on the two bottom rows; eighteen in a hive.
notToBeConfusedWith: The Cloudflare Worker in worker/, which serves the game and keeps the table.

entities.title: Peel
entities.summary: An alien turning out of the hive on a circular arc, before it dives.

entities.title: Dive
entities.summary: An alien flying down at the ship, steering toward it and firing, until it leaves the bottom of the screen.

entities.title: Escort
entities.summary: A guard flying in formation with a diving queen; each escort shot first raises what the queen is worth.

entities.title: Swarm
entities.summary: Five or fewer aliens left: they no longer go home, and dive one after another.

entities.title: Wave
entities.summary: One hive, from full to cleared. Each player has their own wave number, and each wave dives faster and more often.

entities.title: Turn
entities.summary: In a two-player game, one player's play until they lose a ship; then the other plays, if they still have ships.

entities.title: Frame
entities.summary: One fixed step of the game, 1/60 s. Recordings, replays and online lockstep count in frames.

entities.title: Seed
entities.summary: A 32-bit number that fixes every random choice in a game. The server issues it for a game that may enter the table.

entities.title: Ticket
entities.summary: The browser's name for a server-issued seed with its id, fetched ahead of the game that uses it.

entities.title: Runs
entities.summary: A game's recorded controls: [bits, count] pairs, each a run of frames with the same six input bits.

entities.title: Lockstep
entities.summary: Online play in which every browser runs the whole game and steps only once it has every player's controls for that step.

entities.title: Delay
entities.summary: How many steps ahead a browser schedules its own player's controls online, chosen at the start from the measured connections.

entities.title: Fingerprint
entities.summary: A hash of the game's numbers that the browsers compare every 120 steps online, to notice if their games differ.

entities.title: Host
entities.summary: Online, the browser in the lowest slot still in the room: it starts the game, and is player 1.
notToBeConfusedWith: The player who started the game in the lobby: usually the same, unless they left.

entities.title: Games hub
entities.summary: The site's games Worker in another repository: the multiplayer lobby, the match relay, sign-in on this host and /games/play.js.
